literal_meaning: পিতৃতর্পণের জল অর্ঘ্য দেওয়া (water offered in ancestral oblation)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার স্বপ্নকে জলাঞ্জলি দিয়ে ব্যবসা শুরু করেছে।
পড়াশুনায় মন না লাগায় ছেলেটি সবকিছু জলাঞ্জলি দিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has given up his dreams and started a business.
The boy has completely abandoned his studies as he lost interest.
history: Originates from the Hindu ritual of 'tarpan' or offering water to deceased ancestors during shraddha ceremonies, symbolizing final farewell and letting go.
note: The idiom draws from funeral rites, implying irreversible abandonment.
